Mastersizer 3000+ Lab 
The Mastersizer 3000+ Lab is an entry level system for particle size analysis by laser diffraction. This system offers robust size measurements from 0.1 to 1000 microns and benefits from the core experience of the Mastersizer Xplorer software.

 Home 
 Services and Support 
 Training, Application and Expertise ... 
Training, Application and Expertise Services 
 Gain actionable expert insight into your hardware, software, and specific applications with our training and application expertise 
 Download brochure 
 Introduction 
 Training 
 Customized application training 
 Analytical and consultancy services 
 Knowledge Center 
Science is constantly evolving. At Malvern Panalytical, we believe that knowledge sharing is an essential part of delivering value to our customers and advancing scientific understanding.
We offer training courses for every user level and every need, whether you have a new application or need to bring a whole team up to speed. And if you need a partner for your entire analytical journey, our consultancy services can equip you with the tools, insights, and expertise you need.
Benefit from:
Maximized uptime
Accurate data
Fast, expert, local support
Actionable insights
Streamlined operations and communication
Knowledge sharing 
Training 
Gain valuable maintenance tips and tricks, discover how to get the most out of your system, and learn how to determine the accuracy and reliability of your instrument. Basic user training helps you and your partners to use your instruments to their full potential.
View upcoming training 
Customized application training 
Looking for in-depth actionable insights? With customized application training, we can design a training journey tailored to your application needs, all with the help of our application scientists. From sampling and method development to data and results interpretation, we can provide you with the in-depth theory and best practices that will push the boundaries of your analysis.
Request a quote 
Analytical and consultancy services 
Our consultancy services are designed to equip you with the tools, insight, and expertise you need to navigate a wide range of challenges. Our expert analysis service places specialists and scientists at your disposal for method development, sample preparation, and certification. From trace and oxide analysis to screening and small-spot analysis, from particle sizing to molecular interaction – you’ll gain unparalleled analytical expertise. Our services are designed to help you get consistent, repeatable, and accurate results every time, in a way that meets your ambitions.
Request a quote 
XRF testing services 
 Learn more 
 XRF testing services 
 Our specialized X-ray service goes even further
 : We have the know-how and experience to support you every step of your X-ray analysis, from your sample arriving in the lab to reporting your final results. Optimize your laboratory process – we can create custom reference/calibration materials for you, advise on sample preparation and develop your method – all harmonized, in one flow, from a single supplier.
 Request a quote
Knowledge Center 
Our knowledge center is an extensive library of webinars, white papers, application notes, manuals, and technical articles on all aspects of your application and Malvern Panalytical instruments. 
They cover a range of practical topics, such as how to calibrate your instruments, troubleshoot a problem, and learn about different functions. Every resource is designed to enhance your understanding, improve your skills, and elevate your analytical outcomes.
Visit the Knowledge Center
